selection.rule: Use the pre-randomized unconditional 12h audit tranche from the frozen exploratory cohort manifest.

system_condition.replicate_identifier_scope: Local identifiers do not pair provider randomness. Contrasts are unpaired exploratory system-level comparisons unless the provider later exposes controlled randomness.

arms.state_continuity: one greedy process retains its selected incumbent artifact and agent-visible incumbent metrics throughout the run

arms.initial_state: each restart begins from the identical frozen task baseline
arms.state_continuity: no artifact, visible metrics, prompt history, provider context, or workspace transfers between restarts

proposal_budget.interpretation: safety ceiling only; any run exhausting it before its wall horizon is protocol_incomplete and not a completed arm

sentinels.late_result_policy: Retain a result completing after cutoff, but prevent it from changing the in-horizon incumbent or feedback.
sentinels.hidden_snapshot_policy: No post-hoc hidden-snapshot winner may replace committed or terminal endpoints.

endpoint_estimands.restart_aggregation: For fresh_restart_6x2h, report all six terminal outcomes and a separately labeled observer best-of-six upper envelope. The upper envelope is not an autonomous deployable endpoint.
endpoint_estimands.continuous_comparison: Compare continuous terminal with the distribution, mean and observer best-of-six restart endpoints; retain task-level results and do not infer a population effect from three result-selected tasks.

what_the_ablation_isolates: Continuation of the online incumbent artifact plus agent-visible incumbent metrics under the greedy scaffold, jointly with new provider draws.
what_the_ablation_does_not_isolate: a structured scientific notebook or hypothesis ledger
workspace files beyond the incumbent artifact
the base model independent of scaffold and service

failure_and_stopping.risk_set: Run every scheduled continuous and restart cell regardless of early score direction.
failure_and_stopping.infrastructure_retry: Resume only the identical hash-bound cell and pending provider result; retain all failed attempts.
failure_and_stopping.candidate_invalidity: Retained as an outcome and consumes a proposal slot.
failure_and_stopping.signed_stop: record_only: a commit or abstain is retained as an endpoint decision but forced continuation proceeds to the wall horizon.
failure_and_stopping.protocol_incomplete: Proposal-ceiling exhaustion, baseline exceeding horizon, missing sentinel, contract drift, or non-equivalent total active time fails the affected cell closed.

analysis_restrictions: This three-task cohort was selected after current GPT-5.5 calibration outcomes and is not confirmatory.
A 2h restart told its true horizon is not interchangeable with a 2h prefix of a 12h-aware continuous run.
Same-number local identifiers do not create paired model randomness.
Do not average heterogeneous mechanism, robustness and validation axes into a single discovery score.
Do not call a continuous advantage evidence that long context caused learning; the retained state is specifically artifact plus visible metrics.
preflight_requirements: fixed-artifact evaluator noise and deterministic replay
evaluator resolution and scientific materiality thresholds
cohort and runtime contract hash verification
local keyless endpoint availability and model-condition hash
sufficient proposal safety ceiling to reach every wall horizon
